Ashley Digital is the e-commerce engine behind Ashley Furniture Industries — one of the most recognized home brands in the world. As the world's largest manufacturer of home furnishings and the largest furniture store brand in North America, Ashley is in a category unto itself. Our team sits at the intersection of world-class retail and digital innovation, driving the e-commerce experience for millions of customers across every platform and touchpoint. If you’ve shopped online for a mattress in the last decade, there’s a good chance you’ve already experienced our award-winning Nectar Sleep and DreamCloud. We're a fast-moving, highly collaborative team operating at a transformational moment, and we're charged with shaping how people discover, explore, and buy home furnishings. Our expertise spans data science, performance marketing, product, and creative, and our work reaches millions of customers every day. It's a rare combination: the energy of a tech company, the stability of an industry leader, and the opportunity to build something truly significant. If you're energized by transformation, collaboration, and meaningful impact at scale, Ashley Digital is where ambition meets opportunity.

To be considered for this remote opportunity, you must reside and be authorized to work within the United States.

About the Role:

Ashley Furniture is seeking a Director, Consumer Insights to build a modern insights capability that brings the voice of the consumer, retail customer, sales associate, and marketplace into the decisions that shape Ashley's products, experiences, and growth. This role will own the insights operating model, custom research roadmap, insights repository, and decision-ready synthesis across Ashley's priorities. It is expected to shape questions, prioritize learning opportunities, and drive adoption of insights across teams. This is a builder role for someone who combines research rigor, scrappy resourcefulness, strong collaboration, and hands-on ownership of analysis, synthesis, and executive-ready storytelling. The right person is energized by creating practical ways of working where a mature insights function hasn't historically existed, finds credible ways to answer business questions with available resources and imperfect data, and is comfortable doing the work directly — analyzing data, building slides, pressure-testing findings — rather than depending on external partners.

Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing, the Director will partner across business units and functions; Tampa, FL is preferred, with openness to remote candidates who can travel as needed.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Establish Ashley's insights capability as a practical force in product, marketing, retail, and customer experience decisions, bringing a builder mindset to a function still taking shape.
  • Design and manage learning plans and custom research initiatives, translating ambiguous business questions into clear research objectives, survey instruments, discussion guides, sample plans, analysis frameworks, and actionable readouts — with the quantitative rigor to make findings clear, defensible, and useful.
  • Synthesize research data, customer feedback, business inputs, and supplier outputs to develop implications for decision-ready presentations, working scrappily and resourcefully to answer business questions even when data or resources are imperfect.
  • Build relationships across functions by demonstrating the practical value and business impact of insights, connecting dots across business units, channels, and stakeholder groups as an enterprise collaborator.
  • Own Ashley's insights repository and knowledge hub, including searchable findings, source materials, reusable learnings, and AI-enabled synthesis workflows.
  • Create a disciplined intake and prioritization process for insights work, balancing stakeholder requests against business impact, decision timing, available resources, and the quality of existing evidence.
  • Manage and develop one direct report, including coaching, prioritization, quality review, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Turn complex research into sharp, memorable, commercially useful takeaways that move decisions forward, operating as an influential storyteller across audiences with varying levels of research fluency.

The responsibilities described above are not exhaustive. You may be asked, from time to time and as reasonably required by business needs, to perform other duties consistent with your skills and role, including work for or on behalf of our related entities. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment and may be modified at any time, subject to applicable law.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 8+ years in consumer/customer insights, market research, UX research, strategy, product marketing, or customer experience; director-level experience preferred. Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Proven experience designing and executing custom research (surveys, panels, concept testing, feedback programs, qualitative and quantitative methods) and synthesizing multi-source data into insight storytelling.
  • Ability to connect consumer, customer, retail, and marketplace signals to product strategy, merchandising, pricing, and growth priorities — communicated through concise, commercially grounded executive recommendations.
  • Fluency with AI-enabled research and knowledge management tools, used to accelerate synthesis without outsourcing judgment.
  • Comfortable operating with incomplete inputs and limited resources while maintaining research discipline.
  • Strong track record influencing across a matrixed organization with varying levels of research fluency.
  • People management experience, with a high-ownership mindset suited to building an insights function from an early stage.
  • Able and willing to travel to company on-site meetings in Tampa, FL

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in furniture, home goods, appliances, or other high-consideration retail/ecommerce categories.

jobs.excerpt: Over StaxxerE-commerce groeit explosief.  Steeds meer ondernemers verkopen internationaal en worden geconfronteerd met complexe btw-regels, EPR-verplichtingen en een hoop administratieve rompslomp.
jobs.description:
Over Staxxer

E-commerce groeit explosief. Steeds meer ondernemers verkopen internationaal en worden geconfronteerd met complexe btw-regels, EPR-verplichtingen en een hoop administratieve rompslomp. Bij Staxxer maken we dat makkelijk. Wij bouwen aan dé totaaloplossing voor de financiële backoffice van e-commerce verkopers, volledig geautomatiseerd en zonder het stoffige imago dat je vaak bij boekhouding ziet.

Staxxer is ontstaan vanuit de behoefte van e-commerce ondernemers. Daardoor weten we precies wat onze klanten nodig hebben: duidelijke communicatie, slimme software en een team dat écht met ze meedenkt. Geen moeilijke woorden of eindeloze wachttijden, maar snelle actie en eerlijke antwoorden.

We bedienen inmiddels honderden klanten in Nederland, en nu is het tijd voor de volgende stap: een complete boekhoudservice die perfect aansluit op onze software en dienstverlening. Ons doel? De nummer één boekhoudoplossing voor e-commerce in Nederland worden en daar hebben we jou bij nodig.

Ben jij die moderne boekhouder die energie krijgt van automatisering, graag werkt met ondernemers die vooruit willen, en zin heeft om iets nieuws op te bouwen vanaf de basis? Dan is dit jouw kans om het verschil te maken.

Over de functie

Je gaat aan de slag als boekhouder voor onze Nederlandse klanten. Een dag bij ons bestaat uit veel én veelzijdig klantcontact. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt voor jouw klanten, en je wordt indien nodig met vraagstukken bijgestaan door onze fiscalisten, accountmanagers of tech-afdeling.

Wij zoeken:

  • Een boekhouder met minstens 2 jaar werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie;

  • Iemand die verantwoordelijkheid neemt over zijn/haar taken;

  • Een zelfstandige houding;

  • Een flexibele instelling: in een een snelgroeiende scale-up wil er namelijk nog wel eens wat veranderen;

  • Een actieve houding: we horen graag wat je denkt!

  • Iemand met basiskennis over btw (Europese btw-kennis is een pré).

Jij krijgt:

  • De flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid om te werken waar en wanneer je wil;

  • Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van achtergrond en ervaring (€3.000 - €4.000);

  • Een onbeperkt aantal vakantiedagen, uiteraard in overleg met je collega's;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en training omtrent het Europese btw- en EPR-systeem (learning on the job);

  • Een MacBook en iPhone van de zaak;

  • Interessante klanten met grote ambities en natuurlijk leuke collega's;

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te groeien binnen een snelgroeiende scale-up en jezelf persoonlijk te ontwikkelen;

  • De ruimte om jouw ideeën uit te voeren en het team te versterken;

  • Een tof kantoor in het centrum van Nijmegen, 15 minuten lopen van het CS (met af een toe een gezellige borrel).

  • Werk je liever vanuit huis? Geen probleem! Kom je toch naar kantoor? Alleen maar gezellig. De keuze is aan jou.

Requirements

Je hebt/bent:

  • Minstens 2 jaar werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie;

  • Basiskennis over btw is een vereiste;

  • Kennis over internationale btw is een pré;

  • Secuur;

  • Flexibel;

  • Verantwoordelijk;

  • Communicatief sterk;

  • Leergierig;

  • De motivatie om een vraagstuk tot op de bodem uit te zoeken;

  • Geschikt voor werken in een scale-up: “it is gonna be a fun, but bumpy ride”;

  • Vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal en comfortabel met Engels.

  • Minimaal 32 uur beschikbaar

Highlights

Ons doel? De slimste en meest geautomatiseerde boekhoudservice voor e-commerce worden. Onmisbaar voor online verkopers. En jij kunt daar vanaf het begin aan meebouwen.

jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The Sr IT Auditor II is responsible for the understanding and evaluation of the internal control and risk environment within Assurant, Inc. at the assigned business or enterprise functional and includes (but not limited to) the following objectives:

What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?

The Sr IT Auditor II responsibilities include the following activities:

Lead Audit Projects (up to 70%)

The primary function of this role is to lead projects that identify risks, evaluate IT controls and report key findings for assigned business areas, and assess their impact to Assurant’s mission, strategy, and related business objectives. Specific tasks include but are not limited to the following:

  • Use knowledge of IT and general business to design, lead and execute risk-based IT audit programs for business process reviews, system implementations, and application reviews and other IT processes through all phases of the audit including planning, testing, and providing written reports of key findings.

  • Assess opportunities to improve the internal control environment across the company.

  • Communicate effectively with all levels of management and staff through written reports and oral presentations.

  • Develop an understanding of Assurant Businesses and maintain awareness of significant industry, regulatory and business changes across the organization and their potential impact on the established control environment.

  • Pursue professional development opportunities and share lessons with colleagues.

SOX / MAR / External Auditor Assistance

The role may require the individual to support and/or coordinate SOX/MAR compliance or External Auditor Assistance activities through the execution of testing and communication to management. Specific tasks include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Participate in the development, review and implementation of test documentation, control narratives, procedures, and control testing.

  • Execute business test strategy to ensure the activities are performed in accordance with the SOX/MAR plan.

  • Review documentation for quality, consistency, and relevance.

  • Participate in periodic scoping and account mapping of significant processes.

  • Work with and support external auditors as required.

The role may be required to develop the business relationships that enable IAAS to fulfill its charter and meet stakeholder expectations. Specific tasks include (but not limited to) the following:

  • Become a trusted, objective, and independent partner that is sought after to provide cost-effective, independent assurance and advice on the effectiveness of the company’s management of critical risks.

Lead Audit Teams (up to 10%)

Specific tasks may include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Create and edit professional communications using a variety of mediums with information provided by department leaders for executive or high-profile audience.

  • Create, maintain, and communicate internal department policies and information using the department SharePoint sites.

  • Create, maintain, and report on department metrics through dashboards and reports that demonstrate best practices in data visualization and continuously monitor and report on department performance to department leaders.

But this isn't a role where everything is handed off. We need someone who can turn an early idea into a visual concept, prototype, or campaign direction and use AI tools to explore and produce creative work faster.

This is a senior, hands-on role with significant influence over how Oddin is perceived in the industry. You'll help us evolve an established identity, create stronger consistency across the company, and build a brand system capable of scaling across multiple products, audiences, and markets.

jobs.description:
This position is not open to applicants residing in or otherwise based in California, New York, Illinois, or Massachusetts. Additionally, applicants must be located in the Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones.

Note to Applicants

We’re looking for professionals who take pride in their work. We know your resume tells part of the story, but our application questions help us understand how you think and work. Because we receive a high volume of applications, only applications with complete, thoughtful responses will be reviewed.

Given the AI restriction on this engagement, described below, we ask that your responses be your own work.

Engagement Details

This is instructional design work, with a twist.

Every project starts with an existing course and a charter that defines exactly what is changing about it. The work is reading that charter closely, translating it into specific revisions in specific places, and executing them cleanly on a short, fixed cycle, without drifting into the parts of the course the charter does not cover.

It calls on the full instructional design skill set: learning theory, alignment, assessment design, accessibility, and SME collaboration. What is distinctive is where the difficulty sits. The hard calls here are about scope and defensibility: deciding what a charter line means in practice, and documenting why you drew the line where you did. It also means finding things you would want to change and leaving them alone. If your instinct when you open a course is to fix everything you find, this engagement will frustrate you. If you can see all of it and still deliver only what the charter covers, documenting the rest for the partner, you should do well here.

You will work with Subject Matter Experts and coordinate with internal teams, including Editorial and Quality Review, ensuring every revision adheres to research-based practice and partner-defined quality standards.

This engagement carries a partner data restriction. No partner course content, materials, or partner-provided information may be entered into, uploaded to, or processed by any AI system, internal or external, at any point during the engagement.

This is an independent contractor engagement (1099). Contractors are free to work with other clients, and accepting one project carries no obligation to accept another. Meeting times are set in advance around each project’s milestones. Outside of those scheduled meetings and agreed deadlines, you determine your own working hours and process for completing the work.

Scope of Work

  • Complete a scoped review of the assigned course and map the charter to specific course locations, documenting cascading effects, assumptions, and ambiguities before development begins.
  • Deliver a specific list of items requiring SME input before the first working session.
  • Collaborate with SMEs to revise instruction and assessments in scope, aligned to learning outcomes and the charter, while documenting anything outside scope rather than addressing it.
  • Suggest relevant open educational resources and instructional methods appropriate to the revision.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of design decisions to support partner review and approval.
  • Incorporate partner and stakeholder feedback through agreed revision cycles.
  • Facilitate SME working sessions to obtain the approvals required to complete deliverables.
  • Coordinate with internal teams at defined handoff points to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
  • Complete self-QA before each handoff and deliver complete, accurate work by each fixed milestone.
  • Submit a status update with each milestone deliverable, and flag anything that's off track as soon as you identify it, so downstream stakeholders aren't caught by surprise.
  • Work from the version of the design standards and charter in effect for your project. Both may be revised between projects as the program evolves.

What You Need to Get the Job Done

  • Advanced degree in Education, Instructional Technology, or a related field.
  • Current, in-depth knowledge of instructional design and learning theories, with expertise in online learning, instructional design and technology, adult learning theory, and andragogy/pedagogy.
  • Demonstrated experience (3-5 years) collaborating with SMEs on online course development in higher education or corporate environments.
  • Proven ability to build strong working relationships with SMEs while moving projects forward and meeting deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead and influence collaboratively, including holding a scope boundary professionally.
  • Ability to read a scope document and identify not just what it says, but what it means in practice: what it touches, what it doesn’t, and what’s ambiguous.
  • Strong independent judgment: the ability to make a clean, documented, defensible decision on an ambiguous question without needing every call reviewed.
  • Experience with ADA compliance and quality standards for course design (e.g., Quality Matters, OLC).
  • Competency navigating various LMS systems such as Brightspace, D2L, Canvas, Moodle, etc.
  • Ability to recognize AI-generated material in SME submissions and evaluate it critically against design standards and learning objectives.
  • Ability to pick up a revised standard or specification between projects and apply it accurately, without a ramp-up period.
  • Strong organizational skills, excellent follow-through, and exceptional attention to detail.

Is This Engagement Right for You?

  • Trust that addressing what’s in scope serves the student better than expanding into what isn’t.
  • Naturally front-load your prep, arriving at meetings with a plan rather than still forming one.
  • Can hold a professional boundary on scope with a SME without straining the relationship.
  • Comfortable working without AI assistance on partner content.
  • Deliver complete, accurate work on a hard deadline, consistently.
  • Communicate proactively, especially when something is going wrong.
  • Pick up a revised standard between projects and apply it, without defaulting back to the previous version.

What Will Make Us REALLY Love You

  • A proven track record of working with academic and business partners to create engaging and effective online courses.
  • Excellent oral/written communication and presentation skills.
  • Background in Learner Experience Design.
  • Expertise in competency-based learning.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of available open educational resources (OERs).
  • Quality assurance training and certification (QM, OSCQR, other).
  • Post-secondary teaching and learning experience.

About Customer.io

Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Michael, Head of Data & Analytics at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help our teams make better decisions using customer and product data.

You'll partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Experience to evaluate product changes, design and analyze experiments, identify opportunities to improve the customer experience, and influence roadmap and business priorities. This is a hands-on role focused on analyzing behavior, building models, and turning data into clear, actionable direction.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working closely with stakeholders, and applying data science pragmatically to support product and business decisions. We're looking for someone with an ownership mindset and a bias for action who balances technical rigor with practical decision-making.

What we value

Ownership: You take initiative and drive analytical work from concept to implementation. You don't wait for perfect requirements — you help define the problem and move the work forward.

Curiosity: You naturally question assumptions and dig deeper into the "why" behind user behavior. You enjoy uncovering patterns in complex data and have the persistence to work through ambiguity and messy datasets.

Analytical Rigor: You bring a thoughtful, structured approach to analytics and decision-making. You know how to define meaningful measures of success, evaluate changes with rigor, and distinguish signal from noise in complex behavioral data so teams can act with confidence.

Communication: You can translate complex analytical concepts into clear recommendations for Product Managers, executives, and non-technical stakeholders.

Collaboration: You work as a true cross-functional partner, balancing analytical rigor with practical business needs. You build trust by making data approachable, actionable, and reliable.

What you'll do

  • Analyze behavioral patterns across the customer lifecycle to identify trends, usage archetypes, and opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and retention.
  • Design experiments and measurement approaches to evaluate the impact of product and marketing changes - and help teams make decisions based on evidence rather than intuition.
  • Build models and datasets that improve how teams segment customers, forecast outcomes, and identify trends.
  • Apply machine learning and AI techniques where they solve practical problems, for both internal decision-making and customer-facing scenarios.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to improve the quality, reliability, and accessibility of core data and metrics.
  • Communicate findings clearly and directly so teams can make informed decisions without needing a statistics background.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in a Data Science role within B2B SaaS or a similar product- or growth-focused environment.
  • Strong foundation in statistics, experimentation, and behavioral analytics - with the ability to apply them pragmatically to real product and business problems.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python for large-scale analysis, modeling, and exploration.
  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar); familiarity with dbt is a plus.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills - you can explain complex analysis clearly to PMs, marketers, executives, and non-technical partners.
  • An ownership mindset - you help define the problem and move work forward; you don't wait for perfect requirements.

Why This Role

This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact problems across the business while helping shape how data science and analytics evolve within the organization. You'll have the autonomy to explore meaningful questions, influence strategy, and help build a stronger data-informed culture.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $140,000-$150,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  • 30-minute call with Recruiter
  • 45-minute call with Hiring Manager
  • 45-minute 1:1 Technical Interview
  • Take-Home Assignment + 45-minute review call

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact .

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking an accomplished Director of Product, Enterprise to lead a major pillar of our Product organization. In this role, you will define the vision, strategy, and execution for the products that help homebuyers explore and configure their homes, while enabling suppliers and builders to move more quickly from selection to estimating and readiness. You will lead product efforts across Estimate and Showroom, shaping connected experiences that improve buyer confidence, operational speed, and business outcomes.

Serving as a product leader, you’ll guide a portfolio of products that enable homebuilders to efficiently design, estimate, and sell production homes. Expect to:

You’re a strategic and customer obsessed product leader who can move fluidly between consumer style experiences and complex operational workflows. You thrive in environments where product success depends on connecting multiple users, systems, and business processes into one cohesive journey.

jobs.title: Brand Manager, Innovation
jobs.excerpt: About BobbieBobbie makes European-style organic infant formula manufactured end-to-end in the U.
jobs.description:
About Bobbie

Bobbie makes European-style organic infant formula manufactured end-to-end in the U.S., because we believe every parent deserves to feed their baby with confidence, without judgment and without compromise. No mystery ingredients. No shortcuts. Just clean, thoughtfully made formula that parents can trust.

But Bobbie has never been just a formula company. When the 2022 national infant formula shortage left parents across the country unable to feed their babies, we closed our storefront to new customers rather than leave a single existing family without formula. We went to Washington. We got loud. And we opened our Heath, Ohio manufacturing facility to make sure something like that could never happen again.

That's who we are, and that's what you'd be joining.

Bobbie for Change

Our advocacy arm, Bobbie for Change, exists because making great formula isn't enough if the systems around parenthood are still broken. We fight for paid federal parental leave, push for legislation to prevent future formula shortages, advocate for feeding equity, and support families navigating impossible situations, including donating formula to parents impacted by breast and gynecologic cancers through the Bobbie Breasties program.

We're a company that genuinely believes becoming a parent makes you an activist. The people who work here feel that too.

The Role:

The Brand Manager, Innovation will help build the next generation of Bobbie products and growth platforms beyond our core infant formula business. Reporting to the Director of Innovation & Product Success on the New Ventures team, this role will lead innovation from early-stage opportunity identification and concept development through commercialization, launch, and in-market learning.

Sitting at the intersection of brand management, consumer insight, product innovation, and commercialization, the Brand Manager will translate unmet consumer needs and market opportunities into differentiated products that can expand Bobbie’s relationship with families across new formats, occasions, and life stages.

This role will be responsible for shaping opportunities, developing concepts and business cases, partnering cross-functionally through product development, and creating the learning plans needed to determine where Bobbie should invest and scale.

The ideal candidate combines classical brand management training with an innovation mindset, someone who is consumer obsessed, commercially minded, comfortable building from ambiguity, and energized by taking an idea from a blank sheet of paper to an in-market product.

What you will accomplish:

Innovation Strategy & Opportunity Development

  • Help shape Bobbie’s new formats innovation pipeline and identify opportunities for future growth.
  • Identify consumer tensions, emerging behaviors, category trends, and whitespace opportunities that can inspire new products and platforms.
  • Translate consumer and market insights into clear innovation territories, product concepts, and strategic recommendations.
  • Assess opportunities across new formats, occasions, life stages, and categories that can extend Bobbie’s relationship with families.
  • Partner with Insights, Finance, and cross-functional teams to size opportunities and prioritize where Bobbie should play.

Concept & Product Development

  • Lead new product concepts from early-stage ideas through development and commercialization.
  • Develop strong consumer propositions, positioning, product benefits, claims, and reasons to believe.
  • Translate consumer needs into clear product briefs and partner with Product Development and external partners to bring concepts to life.
  • Lead consumer learning throughout development, including concept, claims, product, packaging, and pricing testing.
  • Partner closely with Product Development, Regulatory, Quality, Operations, and Supply Chain to balance consumer desirability, technical feasibility, and commercial viability.
  • Ensure products deliver against the original consumer promise throughout the development process.

Business Case & Stage Gate Leadership

  • Build compelling business cases for innovation opportunities, including market sizing, pricing, COGS, margin, volume potential, and investment requirements.
  • Lead innovation projects through Bobbie’s Stage Gate process, ensuring teams have the insights and recommendations needed to make strong investment decisions.
  • Establish clear hypotheses, success criteria, and learning agendas for early-stage innovation.
  • Identify key risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs and drive cross-functional teams toward decisions.
  • Recommend when opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or stop based on consumer and business learning.

GTM & Launch

  • Partner with Marketing, Creative, Sales, DTC, Operations, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, and Finance to build integrated go-to-market plans.
  • Develop recommendations for positioning, pricing, pack architecture, channel strategy, claims, messaging, and launch approach.
  • Manage key milestones, dependencies, decisions, and risks to ensure launch readiness.
  • Ensure the consumer proposition translates consistently from the product itself through packaging, communications, and the end-to-end consumer experience.

Test, Learn & Scale

  • Build learning plans for new products and platforms, including DTC pilots and other test-and-learn approaches.
  • Define clear measures of product-market fit and innovation success before launch.
  • Monitor early performance including trial, repeat, subscription behavior, consumer feedback, ratings and reviews, and unit economics.
  • Translate in-market learning into recommendations to optimize, scale, pivot, or discontinue new products.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to develop the roadmap for successful concepts as they move from incubation into scaled businesses.

Consumer & Market Insights

  • Maintain a deep understanding of Bobbie consumers and the evolving needs of parents and families.
  • Stay close to emerging consumer behaviors, competitive innovation, category disruption, and broader food, nutrition, wellness, and CPG trends.
  • Partner with Insights to design research that answers critical innovation questions and reduces uncertainty.
  • Synthesize consumer, competitive, financial, and performance data into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Bring the consumer voice into every stage of the innovation process.

What we would like you to have:

  • 4–5+ years of experience in Brand Management, Innovation, New Product Development, Product Marketing, or related CPG roles; classical brand management training strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and commercializing new products from concept through launch, ideally within food, nutrition, wellness, or consumer products.
  • Strong consumer, analytical, and commercial instincts with the ability to translate insights and data into compelling product concepts and business recommendations.
  • Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive projects forward in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • A builder mindset with strong strategic thinking, curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward action.

You’re inspired by our core values:

  • Be Radical - We are change makers, rule breakers and stigma shakers. We are unapologetically bold and use our megaphone for good.
  • Nurture the Tension - Parenthood is full of healthy tension, and so is building a company. We embrace the unknowns, practice humility and are a culture of learners.
  • Deliver Ounce by Ounce - Our customers have entrusted us to feed their babies. We lose sleep over the details, so they don’t have to.
  • Don’t Assume - We embrace our unique perspectives, withhold judgment, and find beauty in the paths that brought us all to Bobbie. Our strength is celebrating each other and our collective voice.

Compensation and Benefits:

Compensation

Our salaries are based on paying competitively for our size and industry. For fully remote roles, we have a single salary target per role that is differentiated based on geographic location (Group A, B, or C).

  • Group A (SF/Bay Area, Seattle, NYC): $142,500
  • Group B (Los Angeles, Chicago, Austin, Denver, Boston, Washington DC, San Diego, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento): $128,500
  • Group C (All Other Cities): $121,000

Benefits

  • Competitive stock options
  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee medical, dental, and vision insurance 100% covered by Bobbie, with options to add dependents through a subsidized pre-tax deduction
  • US-based remote work model
  • Flexible Time Off Policy (including Summer Fridays; half days on Fridays Memorial Day through Labor Day)
  • 16 paid company holidays, plus an end of year holiday shut down
  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave with the option to take an additional 8 months unpaid
  • One year subscription to Bobbie
  • $75 monthly internet stipend
  • Co-working space reimbursement

At Bobbie, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive company. We seek to create a culture where everyone can belong because we believe that people do their best work when they can show up every day as their authentic selves. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

Bobbie is an equal opportunity employer. We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.

🚀 Looking for your next role? Join Fraxion, a high-growth SaaS company with a dynamic, collaborative culture and global reach, with offices in Cape Town, South Africa, and the USA.

Position Overview

Fraxion is hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager to own the strategy, tooling, and outcomes of our customer success function. This is a player-coach role: you’ll carry a book of strategic accounts directly, while also owning the systems (HubSpot, Gainsight) that the rest of the CS team runs on, and mentoring other CSMs on discovery, expansion, and retention practice. You report to the Director of Customer Success and work closely with Sales, Product, and Support to keep customers healthy, growing, and renewing.

What You’ll Do

Own strategic accounts

  • Manage a portfolio of Fraxion’s most strategic and complex customers end-to-end, from onboarding through renewal.
  • Run structured discovery with clients to understand how they’re actually using Fraxion’s spend management platform which modules, which workflows, where the friction is, and where the unrealized value sits.
  • Translate discovery findings into expansion opportunities: additional modules, additional users, added PunchOut/vendor connections, or deeper AP automation partnering with Sales on the commercial motion.
  • Own retention and growth metrics for your book: net revenue retention, gross churn, adoption, and NPS/CSAT.

Own the customer success tech stack

  • Serve as the internal owner and administrator of HubSpot and Gainsight (or equivalent CS platform) for the Customer Success org configuration, health scoring models, playbooks, reporting, and data hygiene.
  • Build and maintain the health-score and lifecycle models the rest of the CSM team works from, so risk and expansion signals surface before they become a surprise.
  • Define what “good” looks like in the tools segmentation, cadence triggers, renewal alerts and keep the team accountable to using them consistently.
  • Partner with RevOps/Sales Ops on data flow between HubSpot, Gainsight, and any billing or product-usage systems.

Lead migrations and platform transitions

  • Lead the customer-facing side of migrating clients from legacy platforms or prior Fraxion product generations to current Fraxion offerings, with minimal disruption to the customer’s operations.
  • Build repeatable migration playbooks (data mapping, cutover sequencing, validation, rollback plans, communication templates) that the broader CS team can run without reinventing the process each time.
  • Coordinate with Implementation, Product, and Engineering to scope migration effort and set realistic customer expectations.

Build the function

  • Mentor and coach other CSMs on discovery technique, expansion conversations, and tool usage raising the floor across the team even without formal management authority over headcount.
  • Develop and refine playbooks for onboarding, quarterly business reviews, risk escalation, and renewal.
  • Represent the voice of the customer in product and roadmap conversations, backed by data from the CS tech stack rather than anecdote.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in customer success, account management, or a closely related client-facing role in B2B SaaS, including experience leading or effectively running a CSM organization or function not just carrying an individual book of business.
  • Direct, hands-on ownership of HubSpot and Gainsight (or a comparable enterprise CS platform) you’ve configured health scores, built reporting, and administered the system, not just logged activities into it.
  • A proven track record of running structured discovery with clients you can walk into an account, figure out how it’s actually using a product, and turn that into a credible growth plan.
  • Demonstrated success growing existing accounts through expansion (upsell/cross-sell), not just holding the line on renewal.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting to finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders on the client side as well as executives internally.
  • Comfortable operating with a fair amount of autonomy and owning outcomes without needing a formal management title to drive them.

Nice to Have

  • Experience migrating customers from a legacy platform, competitor product, or prior product generation onto a new platform this is a significant plus given the migration work this role owns.
  • Background in procure-to-pay, AP automation, spend management, or fintech SaaS.
  • Experience working with customers on ERPs such as Sage, Acumatica, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or SYSPRO.
  • Gainsight (or other CSM tool) or HubSpot administrator certification.
  • Experience in a mid-market-focused SaaS organization (as opposed to pure enterprise or pure SMB).

How Success Is Measured

  • Net revenue retention and expansion revenue generated from your account portfolio.
  • Gross churn/logo retention within your book.
  • Adoption of health-scoring and playbooks by the broader CS team, and data quality within HubSpot/Gainsight.
  • On-time, low-friction delivery of any platform migrations you lead.

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

Key Responsibilities

Offboarding

  • Manage and resolve end-to-end employee exits across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and their employees.
  • Provide sound guidance and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
  • Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.
  • Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
  • Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
  • Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, amongst other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.
  • Be the subject-matter expert and respond to internal and external queries on all offboarding matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.
  • Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.
  • Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.
  • Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.
  • Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.

Key Requirements and Charactristics

  • Experience as a HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
  • Proven experience with a strong background in managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR support and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, undertake research, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
  • Basic understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
  • Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
  • Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.
  • Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.

Practicals

  • Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions

Summary


This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.

Job description summary

The Data Innovation, Partnerships and Products (DIPP) team sits within the Data Products and Foundations pillar of SPT and is focused on enabling trusted, scalable data access and partnerships that support improved decision-making across Novartis.

The Director, MAPS (Market Access, Patient Services) and Medical Data Partnerships Lead will play a critical role in establishing and managing strategic data partnerships that support the US Commercial organization and broader SPT priorities.

This position will be responsible for overseeing Novartis’s existing strategic data partnerships within DIPP to ensure compliance and quality are maintained and that Novartis teams have the appropriate systems, processes, and data access to meet business needs.

As the Director, MAPS and Medical Data Partnerships Lead, this role will focus on managing external data partnerships, monitoring spend, and ensuring that partnerships meet data needs, established data standards, governance expectations, and regulatory requirements. The role will collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess partnership effectiveness, track partnership performance and spend, enforce data stewardship practices, and ensure data assets are leveraged effectively across the organization.

The role will also help identify new and innovative data offerings and evaluate where AI can be responsibly integrated into partnership models, data workflows, and commercial use cases to improve speed, in-sight generation, and enterprise value.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the performance and outcomes of external data partnerships, including third-party platforms, vendors, and technology solutions
  • Develop and execute the organization’s data partnership strategy, including the identification of the organization’s critical data needs
  • Partner with Medical, Market Access, and Patient Services stakeholders to identify, evaluate, and manage external data partnerships that strengthen medical insights, real-world evidence, access, patient services, field medical execution, and outcomes-oriented decision-making
  • Work collaboratively to ensure data is addressing use cases Identify and evaluate innovative data offerings in collaboration with the Innovative Data Offerings team, emerging data sources, and opportunities to integrate AI-enabled capabilities that enhance customer engagement, marketing effectiveness, decision-making, and scalable business impact
  • Establish data quality SLAs and metrics with external data partners to ensure high quality data remains available for Novartis teams
  • Working with Data Monitoring and Standards, monitor and enforce data quality, security, and compliance standards for all external data sources, platforms, and vendors, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies for data management
  • Work collaboratively with data vendors and cross-functional teams to address data quality issues and communicate any corresponding changes
  • Facilitate acquisition of data from requirements gathering through integration into Novartis’s platforms and systems
  • Establish oversight mechanisms for external data partnerships, ensuring compliance with data standards, data-sharing agreements, and internal policies for data management
  • Support the implementation of data stewardship practices across platforms, vendors, and technology solutions, to verify data is properly managed and governed throughout the partnership, providing performance metrics and governance reports to senior leadership
  • Coordinate training and awareness initiatives with internal teams around best practices to promote effective and compliant data usage
  • Continuously evaluate existing partnerships and technology solutions to ensure standards across the broader set of DIPP data partnerships are maintained

Novartis seeks an individual with extensive experience in establishing and managing data partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of the data partnership landscape, including industry best practices for collaborating with external data providers. Experience working for a data vendor or working extensively with functional or therapeutic area data is highly desirable, particularly where that experience includes translating business needs into data requirements and ensuring data can be effectively integrated, governed, and used. A proven ability to navigate data-related risks—such as privacy, security, and compliance issues—while building mutually beneficial partnerships is essential. The successful candidate will be committed to driving continuous improvement in the organization’s data partnership strategy, leveraging data insights and industry trends to strengthen collaboration and maximize the value of external data assets.

The ideal candidate should also bring curiosity and practical experience evaluating emerging data capabilities, including AI-enabled tools, advanced analytics opportunities, and new partnership models that can expand how data is accessed, integrated, and applied across the business.

Essential Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field
  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in establishing and managing data partnerships, with a strong focus on data governance, data management, or related roles
  • Expert understanding of data partnership principles, frameworks, and best practices, with a proven ability to forge strategic collaborations with external data providers and vendors
  • Preferred experience working for a data vendor or partnering extensively with data vendors, functional teams, or therapeutic area teams to define, evaluate, integrate, and operationalize data assets
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to data privacy and security
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to influence and drive change in a complex organizational environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess and manage risks associated with external data partnerships, ensuring the integrity, security, and quality of shared data

Novartis Compensation Summary:

The salary for this position is expected to range between $185,500 and $344,500 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.

US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

What you’ll do… The Facilities Manager serves as the primary point of contact for all facilities and equipment maintenance across a multi state portfolio of dental offices. This role is responsible for end to end vendor and work order management, helping ensure safe, reliable, and cost effective operations that support our patients and teams. This position works closely with office teams, regional leadership, Real Estate, IT, and the other Facilities Manager and does not have direct reports. Dental or healthcare experience is highly preferred. This is a remote position; however, candidates will need to reside in one of the following states: Michigan, Ohio, Georgia, Texas, Florida, New Jersey or New York. What you’ll bring to the team…

  • Manage and vet incoming work orders, ensuring requests are legitimate, prioritized appropriately, and routed to the right vendor or resource.
  • Oversee vendors and work orders across multiple states, tracking progress from creation through completion and ensuring timely, high quality work.
  • Partner with office teams to clearly identify the source of issues and limit disruption to office operations and patient care.
  • Maintain office uptime by managing to established KPIs, best demonstrated practices, and service level agreements.
  • Coordinate and document work for general repairs and maintenance, including plumbing, electrical, carpentry, pest control, janitorial, signage, dental equipment, HVAC, masonry, and furniture repair.
  • Serve as the focal point for building and dental equipment emergencies, ensuring rapid response and clear communication among offices, leadership, and vendors.
  • Organize, schedule, and document all work activities; review progress and ensure timely completion with proper records.
  • Obtain proposals and quotes, compare options, and negotiate with vendors to secure best value while maintaining quality and speed.
  • Participate in and support planning and execution for construction, affiliations, office refreshes, relocations, and closures, in partnership with Real Estate and IT.
  • Coordinate with the Facilities Compliance Manager to ensure facilities meet all applicable AHJ and regulatory requirements.
  • Make technical decisions regarding repair versus replacement, scope of work, and vendor recommendations to support uptime, safety, and cost control.
  • Maintain flexibility to respond outside of standard business hours, including evenings and weekends, when urgent facilities or equipment issues arise.

What we require you have…

  • Proven experience in maintenance and facilities management roles, ideally supporting multiple locations or states.
  • Strong understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance processes and related metrics.
  • Knowledge of safety regulations and compliance requirements; healthcare or dental experience is a significant plus.
  • Broad understanding of key trades (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC) and familiarity with dental equipment and building systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross functional teams, including Operations, Real Estate, IT, and Compliance.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey technical issues in clear, simple terms.
  • Strong vendor management skills, including performance management and negotiation across multiple markets.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously, and remain calm and responsive under time pressure.
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems and comfort using reports and dashboards to manage workload.
  • Commitment to staying current on relevant industry trends and technologies impacting facilities and maintenance operations.

About GEDC… Since 1982, Great Expressions has been at the forefront of dental innovation, setting the standard for exceptional care and unforgettable patient experiences. Now, we're entering a new era of transformation, and we want you to be a part of it. Our recently appointed leadership team brings over a century of collective dental expertise and is backed by dynamic investment support to pave the way for groundbreaking changes. We're channeling our resources and energy into revolutionizing our technology platform, expanding service offerings, and creating a personalized patient experience that goes beyond the expected. At Great Expressions, we're not just transforming dentistry; we're investing in the growth and development of our team. Join us and be a part of a career that blends innovation and professionalism, where your contribution shapes the future of dental excellence.

#IND7

GEDC is committed to diversity and inclusion and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are welcomed and encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI) is a market leader in online casino and sports betting, currently operating real-money gaming with our brands: BetRivers.com, PlaySugarHouse.com, and RushBet.co. We’re building bridges between online, social and land-based gaming businesses to create amazing, integrated experiences that keep players in the game.

We are seeking a Director, Affiliate Marketing to lead one of RSI's largest and fastest-growing acquisition channels. Affiliate marketing has become a critical driver of new customer acquisition, and this leader will be responsible for evolving our strategy, technology, partner relationships, commercial model, and team as we continue expanding across regulated markets.

This is a highly visible leadership role that combines commercial ownership, technical expertise, people leadership, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll partner closely with Finance, Product, Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Legal, Compliance, BI, MarTech, and Performance Marketing while leading the strategic direction of RSI's affiliate program.

What You'll Do:

Affiliate Strategy & Growth

  • Develop and execute RSI's affiliate marketing strategy across all active and future regulated jurisdictions.
  • Build strategic relationships with leading affiliate partners and recruit new publishers.
  • Represent RSI at G2E, SBC Summit, ICE Barcelona, and iGB L!VE.
  • Lead affiliate strategy for new market launches.

Commercial Performance & Partner Economics

  • Own one of RSI's largest acquisition budgets and optimize CPA structures using LTV and ROI.
  • Improve forecasting accuracy through stronger commercial governance and payment controls.
  • Partner with Finance on budgeting, accruals, and partner payment processes.

Affiliate Technology & Attribution

  • Own the affiliate technology roadmap from a Growth Marketing perspective.
  • Partner with MarTech, Product, and Engineering to improve attribution, measurement, and affiliate tracking.
  • Understand how affiliates acquire and convert users into a mobile-first business where a majority of revenue is generated through the app. Drive strategies that maximize app installs, deep linking, app-to-registration conversion, and mobile attribution.

Affiliate Operations & Compliance

  • Oversee affiliate operations across regulated jurisdictions.
  • Lead commission structure evolution, partner onboarding, and governance.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance on licensing, T&Cs, responsible gaming, and fraud prevention.

Analytics & Business Intelligence

  • Partner with BI to operationalize partner-level LTV reporting and executive dashboards.
  • Use data to continuously optimize partner investment decisions.

Partner Enablement

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing to ensure affiliates have access to current, high-performing marketing assets.
  • Develop scalable partner communications, business reviews, and promotional planning.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Manage RSI's Affiliate Manager while providing coaching, development, and strategic direction.
  • Oversee the managed services relationship with Affiliate Network, ensuring accountability, service quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Performance Marketing, CRM, Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and MarTech to drive integrated acquisition strategies.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Finance, Analytics, or related field preferred or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • 10+ years of affiliate marketing experience, preferably within regulated gaming.
  • 2+ years of people management experience.
  • Experience managing affiliate programs, agencies, or strategic partners.
  • Deep understanding of CPA, Rev Share, hybrid commission models, LTV, and ROI optimization.
  • Experience with Income Access, Impact, CJ, Partnerize, or similar platforms.
  • Strong commercial and analytical skills.
  • Excellent executive communication skills.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally.
  • Experience with a sportsbook or online casino operator, preferred.
  • Experience with AppsFlyer or other mobile measurement platforms, preferred.
  • Experience launching affiliate programs in newly regulated markets, preferred.
  • Knowledge of mobile attribution, deep linking, and app marketing, preferred.
  • Experience with Sigma, Tableau, or Power BI, preferred.
This role spans a wide breadth of experience at Rush Street Interactive, welcoming candidates with diverse experiences, backgrounds, and locations. The pay range reflects potential variations in experience, skills, and location. The pay range does not reflect total compensation, which includes base pay, benefits, and/or bonuses. For candidates outside the US (Canada, Europe, Latin America), we take a locally informed approach to compensation and will share specific ranges based on your country of residence.

Location Eligibility (for nationwide roles): Open to candidates in eligible locations in the Continental US or Canada.

Location Eligibility (for other roles): Location requirements may vary and will be specified in the job posting.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive medical coverage (HSA & FSA plans), dental, and vision insurance

$130,000—$200,000 USD

What Makes Us Great:

  • Comprehensive compensation
  • Work-life balance initiatives
  • Autonomy – we embrace personal freedom and responsibility
  • Creativity – we are open to new ideas of how we can be better
  • Growth – we want you to develop personally as well as professionally
  • Top-notch professionals who are passionate about what they do

As a rapidly growing company in an emerging industry, you’ll have a huge impact on our product and our company. We like proactive team members and strive to have a company of self-disciplined professionals who enjoy collaboration, having fun, and of course, achieving together what others believe to be improbable. We are dedicated to treating everyone with respect and to support your professional and personal growth.

Overview

In-House Corporate Counsel (Contract | Remote U.S.)

Looking for an opportunity where you can make a real impact? Join our legal team and work alongside experienced business leaders to help shape the future of a global software company.

As In-House Corporate Counsel, you'll play a key role in supporting our business by negotiating and managing commercial agreements, advising on legal and compliance matters, developing policies, resolving disputes, and partnering with leadership on strategic business initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced technology environment while working closely with our Senior Corporate Counsel on Axway's business.

What We're Looking For

  • J.D. from an accredited law school
  • Active membership in good standing with a U.S. state bar
  • At least 2 years of software licensing and commercial contracting experience
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and business partnership skills

What We Offer

  • 6-month contract with the potential to convert to a full-time position based on performance
  • $50–$70 per hour, depending on experience
  • 100% remote opportunity anywhere within the United States
  • Prefer a hybrid environment? We'd love to have you! We also have an office in Scottsdale, Arizona, where you can collaborate in person with our legal team. Our Senior Corporate Counsel is based in Arizona, providing an excellent opportunity for mentorship and close partnership.

If you're looking for a role where your legal expertise will directly influence business decisions while gaining valuable experience with a global software organization, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Oversees, prepares and negotiates legal documents including software licenses, services agreements, vendor contracts, and nondisclosure agreements.
  • Privacy and security experience with data protection agreements and similar agreements.
  • Manages the legal activities of the company with the objective of protecting the company's interests and providing assistance to managers concerning how laws and regulations impact their functional areas.
  • Manage all documents through the legal process.
  • Prepares and reviews proposed contracts, formal agreements and other legal instruments.
  • Manages license compliance, audits of customers.
  • On a daily basis manages all software licensing activities and software contract activities.

Partners closely with Sales and other internal teams (including Sales, Finance, and Operations) with respect to legal matters and contract disposition.

Qualifications

  • Software licensing and service contract experience, in-house experience a plus.
  • General knowledge of laws and regulations applicable to corporations in general and software companies in specific.
  • Detail oriented.
  • Excellent time management, communications, decision making, presentation, human relations, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with various levels of company up to and including senior management
  • Strong business acumen and ability to adapt to changing needs of business.
  • Experience with emphasis on software law, IP rights, employment law, and compliance regulations licensing and commercial transactions
  • Knowledge of financial revenue recognition rules

Education

  • All candidates must have JD from an accredited law school and current bar membership.
  • A minimum of 3 years of legal experience
  • Member in good standing of a State Bar - Arizona

Company Overview

At Axway, we’re more than a company—we’re a pioneer. For 25 years, we’ve been empowering organizations to achieve digital transformation and unlock innovation. With a presence in 100 countries, 11,000+ customers, and a global team of over 1,400+ passionate professionals, Axway is driving the future of enterprise integration.

 

We’re on a mission to be the leader in our space, empowering our customers with secure, mission-critical software to manage and deliver impactful business outcomes from all their digital business interactions.

Why Axway?

We believe in the power of togetherness. When you’re part of Axway, you’re part of a culturally rich and globally connected community that thrives on exchanging ideas and tackling challenges head-on. Whether working remotely or onsite, you’ll find camaraderie, collaboration, and the support of leadership to inspire you daily.

 

Here, you’ll grow, innovate, and succeed because we’re better together. Each step forward in your personal journey is one we take as a team. Join us, and let’s accomplish extraordinary things together.

 

Axway is a proud member of 74Software. Learn more about how Axway is transforming the future: 

 

Ready to shape the future? Let’s get started—because at Axway, together, we can. Together, we will.

Axway is an AA and EEO employer

Company Overview

74Software, affiliated with Axway and SBS, together, we deliver secure, mission-critical software that powers a data-driven world. Independently operated leaders with decades of proven expertise. From secure integration and API solutions to cloud-based banking platforms, we help global organizations and financial institutions thrive.

For more than 25 years, Axway has helped major brands and government agencies worldwide with trusted solutions in Managed File Transfer (MFT), B2B integration, APIs, and Financial Accounting Hub products. SBS empowers banks and financial institutions to reimagine the future with a composable, cloud-based architecture supporting deposits, lending, compliance, payments, consumer finance, and asset finance operations across the globe.

Why 74Software?

We celebrate diverse perspectives and experiences, knowing our people are our greatest strength. Join us and be part of a team where you can thrive, grow, and make an impact.

We offer benefits that support your health, growth, and lifestyle, so you can thrive at work and beyond, including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, flexible work, career development, competitive pay, and global culture perks.

Are you a fast learner who is fascinated by technology?

Do you like collaborating across teams to deliver operational excellence?

Join our Product Experience Team!

We're looking for a Product Analyst to help us understand how customers experience our cloud platform. Partnering with internal teams, you'll work with product usage data, in-app behavioral analytics, and customer journey instrumentation to surface insights that shape how we build, onboard, and grow. We are focused on delivering operational excellence while working in an energetic environment.

Be part of improving our customer experience!

This role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and customer experience. It creates value by translating raw signals into decisions.

As a Product Analyst, you will be responsible for:

  • Partnering with product teams to define what "good experience" looks like and how to measure it
  • Building and maintaining dashboards in tools like Pendo, Tableau, or similar, and using the data to help answer questions and drive our business forward
  • Instrumenting new product surfaces by working with engineers to define event taxonomies, validate tracking, and ensure data quality
  • Analyzing funnels, retention curves, and feature adoption to identify friction points in the customer journey
  • Contributing to our experience metrics framework and helping establish analytics standards across the product organization

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have analytics experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS or developer-focused product environment
  • Be comfortable navigating and working with large datasets
  • Have experience with product analytics platform (Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap, FullStory, or equivalent) and understand event-based instrumentation and measurement
  • Have excellent written and verbal communications skills to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Be a good team player, able to collaborate, prioritize, and solve problems in a fast changing environment
  • Have experience with cloud infrastructure products, developer tooling, or APIs - would be an asset
  • Have familiarity with Python or R for deeper analysis; and exposure to A/B testing frameworks - would be an asset
