jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Product Lead, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

About Giga

Giga is building gigawatts of AI data centers to hasten a future of intelligence and abundance. We build data centers fast and at scale by combining the capabilities of an equipment supplier, engineering firm, general contractor, and real estate developer under one roof. Our team moves quickly and thinks practically. If you're ready to make an impact in an industry that matters, we're looking for people like you.

Why join Giga

  • The Pace: We're building at a speed most companies talk about but never actually operate at. If you've been bored somewhere else, you won't be here.
  • The Impact: Every person at Giga touches the work that matters. No layers, no waiting for approval chains. You'll see your fingerprints on what we ship.
  • The Team: A team of operators defining the future of AI infrastructure. We recruit A-players from the most innovative companies in the world, and they choose Giga because the work here means more.
  • The Moment: AI doesn't run without power, and that's us. Giga is the picks and shovels behind the AI revolution. This industry is about to explode, and you'll be in the room where it's already happening.

What you'll do

As Fire Alarm Engineer at Giga, you will provide technical design leadership and expertise for fire alarm systems, detection systems, smoke control systems, and life safety systems across our AI data center facilities. You'll work on multiple concurrent projects, ensuring technical excellence, design quality, and code compliance while mentoring junior staff and collaborating closely with project teams, clients, and authorities having jurisdiction. This is a hands-on specialist role for someone who wants real technical ownership and thrives in fast-paced, collaborative environments.

Where you'll work

This role is based in one of our offices (Houston, TX / Long Beach, CA / San Francisco, CA / Reno, NV) or fully remote. We work in person because the best engineering happens when smart people are in the same room. Some travel to active project sites and client meetings should be expected.

That said, we will make exceptions for truly exceptional talent if you live outside one of our hubs. If you're the right person for this role, we'll have a conversation about what works.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical design leadership for fire alarm systems, detection systems, smoke control systems, and life safety systems on data center and mission-critical facility projects
  • Design fire alarm and detection systems using manufacturers' equipment and best practices appropriate for data center facilities
  • Design detection and monitoring for lithium-ion battery energy storage and UPS battery systems, including off-gas detection, hydrogen monitoring, and thermal runaway response sequences
  • Develop sequences of operation, equipment schedules, riser diagrams, and device layouts, and prepare and maintain fire alarm specifications
  • Develop smoke control and management strategies aligned with facility operations and life safety requirements
  • Perform quality control review of fire alarm and life safety systems drawings, ensuring technical accuracy, code compliance, and alignment with design intent
  • Provide design guidance and markup comments on other engineers' and designers' submittals, explaining best practices based on real-world data center experience
  • Ensure design compliance with IBC, IFC, NFPA 1, NFPA 101 Life Safety Code, NFPA 72 Fire Alarm and Signaling Code, NFPA 75, NFPA 76, NFPA 92, NFPA 2001, NFPA 2010, NFPA 13, NFPA 855, and NFPA 70 (NEC), and with FM Global Property Loss Prevention Data Sheets as Owner design criteria
  • Coordinate fire alarm and life safety system designs with mechanical, electrical, structural, civil, architectural, and fire protection disciplines
  • Interface with clients, AHJs, and fire alarm contractors to convey and defend design intent, obtain approvals, and resolve technical issues
  • Support field activities including site observation, acceptance testing with AHJs, and resolution of construction-phase issues
  • Mentor junior engineers and drafters on fire alarm system design, code requirements, and best practices
  • Participate in design reviews and quality assurance/quality control efforts across multiple concurrent projects

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience designing fire alarm systems
  • NICET Fire Alarm Systems (FAS) Level III or IV certification
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field
  • Experience working on Data Center projects
  • Extensive knowledge and design experience with fire alarm systems and related manufacturers' equipment, including VESDA aspirating systems, VEWFD spot smoke detectors, and addressable panels
  • Extensive knowledge and design experience with releasing service and suppression interlocks, including preaction and double-interlock preaction systems, clean agent systems, and generator and battery enclosure interfaces
  • Extensive knowledge and design experience with lithium-ion battery hazards, including off-gas detection, hydrogen monitoring, and thermal runaway response sequences
  • Proficiency in IBC, IFC, NFPA 1, NFPA 101 Life Safety Code, NFPA 72 Fire Alarm and Signaling Code, NFPA 75, NFPA 76, NFPA 92, NFPA 2001, NFPA 2010, NFPA 13 and NFPA 855
  • Knowledge and application of FM Global Property Loss Prevention Data Sheets as Owner design criteria
  • Knowledge and application of NFPA 70 (NEC), including Article 760, and electrical design requirements for fire alarm and life safety systems
  • Extensive design experience in data center fire alarm and life safety systems
  • Field experience with fire alarm system installation, testing, and commissioning, including acceptance testing with AHJs
  • Proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD to produce complete construction documents — riser diagrams, device layouts, equipment schedules, and sequences of operation — including battery, voltage drop, and NAC and SLC circuit calculations
  • Proven ability to self-check work, verifying cross-references between sheets, specifications, and sequences of operation, and confirming model numbers against manufacturers' data sheets
  • Able to work with the Engineer of Record on design direction, incorporate review comments, and coordinate with drafters and other design disciplines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain design decisions to the Engineer of Record, clients, and AHJs
  • Able to carry multiple concurrent design assignments and deliver on schedule without sacrificing quality
  • Able to work with minimal day-to-day oversight, make decisions with available information, and move fast in a high-velocity environment

Bonus points

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification
  • Experience estimating and scheduling mid-to-large-scale projects
  • Experience in fire protection and plumbing design is a plus.
  • Familiarity with hyperscale, colocation, and AI-focused data center facility requirements
  • Texas project experience and familiarity with local AHJ processes

How We Work

We value people who take ownership, raise risks early, communicate directly, and follow through. Incomplete information is part of the job. Make the best decision you can, document it, and adjust as the facts change. Move quickly on reversible decisions and take more care when security, safety, financial, employee, or customer risk is involved.

  • 401(k) with 4% employer match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Parental leave
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Commuter benefits, where applicable
  • Opportunities to collaborate in person at periodic team and company on-sites

Giga Energy is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. jobs.excerpt: Location: US or Canada Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor **A note before you read further**The world is changing fast, and so is this role.
jobs.description:
Location: US or Canada
Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor

**A note before you read further**

The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

About Human Agency

We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

Our clients' missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it, and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

The Opportunity

Most designers have a lane. Brand people make things look right. Product people make things work right. Systems people make things scale right. You refuse to pick, and that refusal is exactly what we're after. We work with clients ranging from early-stage ventures to established organizations, all navigating a pivotal moment in how AI is reshaping their products and brands. They need design that holds up at the identity level and at the component level, and they need it from someone who can move fast while also adhering to critical details no one else would think to notice.

This role exists because our clients' design needs don't stop at a logo or a Figma file. They need visual systems that a developer can build from, a brand team can extend, and an AI tool can interpret. You'll be the person who owns that full arc, from first-pass brand exploration through the token naming convention that makes the system actually usable, and you'll do it across multiple client engagements at once.

You've also already reckoned with what AI means for how design gets made. You're not experimenting with it cautiously; you've rebuilt your workflow around it because the old one stopped making sense. That's the standard here, and it's one we're going to keep raising.

What You'll Own

  • Brand Identity & Visual Direction — Lead brand identity work for clients from concept through final delivery, making and defending decisions about typography, color, motion, and voice with the confidence of someone who's done it before and knows why it works.
  • Design Systems Architecture — Build design systems from the ground up (components, documentation, governance), not extend someone else's library. Your systems should be usable by engineers, legible to AI tooling, and maintainable by teams that outlast the engagement.
  • Web & Product Design — Own end-to-end design for web and product experiences, from information architecture and interaction patterns through final specs, with enough craft in the details that clients are delighted on the first round.
  • AI-Augmented Workflow — Use AI tools actively across exploration, iteration, and systemization to move faster and produce more considered work, and share what you're learning with the team so we all get better.
  • Client Collaboration — Present and defend design decisions directly to client stakeholders, translating the reasoning behind visual and systems choices into terms that land with non-designers without dumbing anything down.
  • Cross-Functional Handoff — Work closely with engineers, strategists, and AI practitioners to ensure design outputs are implementable, appropriately scoped, and set the people coming after you up to succeed.

Who You Are

Experience & Skills

  • 6+ years of design experience with meaningful work on both brand identity and digital product, not one with a footnote of the other.
  • A portfolio that includes at least one design system you built from scratch, starting from a brand identity rather than inheriting an existing component library.
  • Demonstrable fluency in Figma, including variables, auto layout, and component architecture at a level that would impress an engineer who's seen bad handoffs before.
  • A real track record of shipping brand identities and web experiences for clients or products people actually use, not just speculative or academic work.
  • Current, working knowledge of AI tools applied to design workflows (generative image tools, LLM-assisted copy exploration, prototyping acceleration, or comparable) used in a way that's changed how you actually work, not just how you talk about working.
  • Strong enough grasp of front-end constraints (HTML, CSS, design tokens, component-based development) to design systems that developers want to build from.
  • Experience working in a consultancy, agency, or multi-client environment where you've had to context-switch across industries and brand voices without losing rigor.

Mindset & Traits

  • You'd rather build the thing than write the deck about why the thing should be built.
  • You're not precious about methodology or tools, but you care about outcomes, and you update your approach when something stops working.
  • You can hold a high aesthetic bar and a high functional bar at the same time without treating them as competing priorities.
  • You take feedback without flinching and give it without softening it into uselessness.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity at the start of a project and disciplined enough to create clarity by the end of it. You want to be somewhere that rewards moving fast and building well, and you're put off by places that side-eye either one.

Logistics

  • Remote-first position open to candidates based in the United States or Canada.
  • This one's Eastern time zone; we need real-time overlap with the team.
  • Contract-to-hire preferred.
  • Some travel may be required for client engagements or team gatherings.

Equal Opportunity Commitment

Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.title: Associate Admissions Advisor
jobs.excerpt: Who we areAt Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe education is more than the pursuit of knowledge – it is a catalyst for transformation.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe education is more than the pursuit of knowledge – it is a catalyst for transformation. Our mission, grounded in democratizing education, is to create access for learners from every background and empower them to achieve their aspirations and advance their careers.

We are committed to delivering rigorous, flexible programs that are both personally fulfilling and professionally rewarding, while contributing to the betterment of society. Since 2004, Yorkville has been among Canada’s few private, for-profit, fully accredited degree-granting universities, with campuses in Ontario, British Columbia, and New Brunswick. Together with Toronto Film School, we offer creative and academic pathways at both the college and university levels, cultivating a multidisciplinary environment where innovation and the arts converge.

Our community is vibrant and diverse. Many of our learners are adults balancing education with careers and personal commitments. Every member of our team – whether in teaching, operations, or technology – is dedicated to removing barriers and expanding access. Together, we deliver flexible, industry-informed learning that leads to meaningful opportunities.

At our core is human connection – guiding people to reimagine their futures in a community defined by opportunity, creativity, and growth.

Who we need

Reporting to the Associate Director of Admissions, we are hiring an Associate Admissions Advisor to support prospective students exploring programs at Yorkville University and Toronto Film School. As our new Associate Admissions Advisor, you will be one of the first points of connection for prospective students, reaching out to understand their educational and career goals, explore their motivation for returning to school, and determine whether their program of interest aligns with what they want to achieve. You will build rapport through high-volume outbound calls, answer initial questions, qualify prospective students, and connect engaged candidates with an Admissions Advisor who can guide them through the next steps in their journey.

This is a fully remote role for candidates based in Ontario. The schedule is 1:00–9:00 p.m. ET, with a bi-weekly Saturday shift.

What's in it for you

A clear path for career growth. This role is designed as a stepping stone to becoming an Admissions Advisor. You will build the communication, relationship-building, and sales skills needed to take the next step in your career while gaining hands-on experience connecting with prospective students, understanding their goals, and guiding them toward the right next step.

A chance to build your sales skills. Whether you are bringing customer service experience or are earlier in your sales career, you will have the opportunity to strengthen your ability to build rapport, ask thoughtful questions, listen for what matters, and confidently engage people over the phone. You will work toward clear goals and KPIs, with the opportunity to earn commission based on your performance.

Support to learn and succeed. You will join leaders who value open communication, coaching, and development. You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced Admissions professionals, receive feedback on your approach, and build the confidence and skills to take on greater responsibility as you grow.

As our new Associate Admissions Advisor, you will

  • Connect with prospective students. You will conduct high-volume outbound outreach to people who have expressed interest in Yorkville University or Toronto Film School. You will create a positive first impression, build rapport quickly, answer initial questions, and engage prospective students in meaningful conversations about their education and career goals.
  • Understand their goals and motivation. You will ask thoughtful questions and actively listen to understand what is motivating each prospective student to explore further education. You will help them consider whether their program of interest aligns with their goals and identify those who are ready to continue the conversation with an Admissions Advisor.
  • Create a seamless next step. You will pre-qualify prospective students and connect engaged, qualified individuals with an Admissions Advisor through scheduled appointments or live transfers. You will help maintain a strong pipeline by keeping conversations moving forward and working toward established outreach and conversion goals.
  • Manage your outreach and results. You will take ownership of a high-volume calling schedule, accurately track your activity, and work toward individual and team KPIs. You will use the team's systems and processes to stay organized, manage follow-ups, and ensure prospective student information is captured accurately.
  • Contribute to the Admissions team. You will work closely with Admissions Advisors and your fellow Associate Admissions Advisors to support prospective students and team goals. You will share insights, participate in team activities and recruiting initiatives, and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative environment focused on student success.

What you bring

  • The communication skills. You are a confident and engaging communicator who can quickly build rapport over the phone. You ask thoughtful questions, listen closely, and adapt your approach based on what you hear, helping prospective students feel comfortable sharing their goals, motivations, and concerns.
  • The customer-focused approach. You have experience working directly with customers, clients, or the public in a service, sales, retail, call centre, or similarly people-focused environment. You know how to create a positive experience while guiding a conversation toward a clear next step.
  • The drive and resilience. You are motivated by goals and comfortable working toward measurable targets. You can maintain your energy through a high volume of outreach, stay positive when a conversation does not go as planned, and move confidently to the next opportunity.
  • The self-management skills. You can structure your day, manage follow-ups, and stay focused in a remote environment. You are organized and accountable, with the ability to balance a consistent outreach schedule with accurate documentation and attention to detail.
  • The motivation to learn. You are open to feedback, coaching, and new approaches that will help you strengthen your sales and relationship-building skills. You are curious, eager to develop, and ready to take ownership of your performance while contributing to the success of the broader Admissions team.

Why work at Yorkville University?

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we are united by a shared purpose: placing the student experience at the heart of everything we do. Whether you are teaching, designing curriculum, advising students, advancing technology, or supporting operations, your work directly fuels learning potential, strengthens inclusive communities, and fosters purposeful curiosity.

Here, professional growth is part of our culture. In your role, you will have opportunities to help the launch of career-relevant programs, expand your expertise, and access tuition-free courses across our institutions - from certificates to master’s degrees. Curiosity, initiative, and innovation are encouraged, and your ideas can move from vision to reality.

Our scale offers the best of both worlds: the reach and stability of a national institution combined with the agility of a mid-sized organization, where contributions are visible and valued. You will be part of a diverse and inclusive community where authenticity is celebrated, collaboration is expected, and impact is shared - on students, colleagues, and your own professional journey.

At Yorkville and Toronto Film School, your work does more than make a difference. It empowers others to achieve their possible, while giving you the opportunity to realize yours.

Compensation philosophy

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe compensation should be fair, straightforward, and supportive of your growth. Our salary ranges reflect progression from learning in the role to excelling, with each offer based on skills, experience, and role complexity.

This role offers a fixed annual base salary of $45,000 plus competitive commission.

We strive for equitable, consistent pay, though rates may vary within the same role based on performance, specialized knowledge, and impact.

Base salary is one part of a broader package that includes paid time away, retirement savings matching, and extended health coverage with 80% of premiums paid. After 12 months of full-time employment, there is also tuition-free access to all our education programs.

We welcome conversations about compensation throughout the hiring process.

Join us

We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we seek, express your interest.

What you can expect from our hiring process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the Associate Director of Admissions and a member of the team. You will have the opportunity to share more about your experience, communication style, and approach to building relationships and achieving goals.
  • A final virtual interview with the Associate Directors of Admissions for Yorkville University and Toronto Film School and the Director. You will have an opportunity to meet members of the leadership team and learn more about the role and the Admissions team.

Diversity, equity, and inclusion are critical components of life at Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, and we are committed to making these values an integral part of our culture. We encourage applications from all qualified applicants, including women, persons with disabilities, Black, Indigenous and People of Colour (BIPOC), people from the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Transsexual, Queer, Questioning, Two-Spirit, Intersex, Asexual + (LGBTQ2SIA+) community and other equity-seeking groups.

Yorkville University is committed to providing accessible employment practices that comply with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation for disability, please notify Human Resources at 1-877-429-4029.

jobs.description:
At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

Building AI-native products is a different problem than building deterministic software: the same input won't always produce the same output. Good product engineering here means designing experiences that stay useful, trustworthy, and easy to understand even when the AI underneath doesn't behave the same way twice — and knowing when that's a product design problem, not just a model problem.

We're looking for a Software Engineer with 2-7 years of experience who thinks like a product owner, not just an implementer. You're comfortable being handed a vague, half-formed problem and figuring out what's actually worth building. You default to empathy for the researcher or participant on the other end of the screen, and you'd rather ship something real and learn from it than wait for a perfect spec. You're fluent enough with modern LLM-based systems to build good product experiences on top of them, even if tuning the model itself isn't your job.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of product features — from an ambiguous problem statement to shipped, working software real researchers and participants use
  • Partner directly with Product and Design to help define what should be built, not just how to build it
  • Use our design system to make sound, independent calls on smaller UX and interaction decisions, and know when a change is big enough to loop Design in
  • Build the product surfaces (web app flows, dashboards, in-product controls) that make AI-driven behavior understandable, controllable, and trustworthy for the people using it
  • Integrate LLM-based features and agent outputs into real product flows — treating them as a building block you design around, not infrastructure you need to own
  • Talk to users directly when you need to; bring what you learn back into design and prioritization decisions
  • Ship fast, instrument what you ship, and iterate based on real usage rather than a fixed spec
  • Collaborate with AI-focused engineers on deeper model or agent tuning when a feature's behavior depends on it
  • Sweat the craft: interaction design, edge cases, error states, and how the feature actually feels to use

What you bring

  • 2-7 years of software engineering experience shipping full-stack product features to real users
  • Comfortable working across the stack (frontend and backend) and picking up whatever's needed to ship
  • A track record of taking a vague, underspecified problem and shipping something real without a fully-scoped ticket
  • Genuine empathy for users: you default to understanding what someone is actually trying to do, not just what the ticket says
  • Working fluency with LLM-based systems: you've built features on top of LLM APIs or agents and understand prompting and non-determinism well enough to design good product experiences around them
  • Strong product judgment: you can reason about tradeoffs (build vs. buy, LLM vs. deterministic logic, speed vs. polish) and push back when a request doesn't serve the user
  • Comfortable using our design system to independently make good UX calls on smaller details, without needing Product or Design sign-off for every decision
  • Comfort using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) as a real part of your workflow
  • High agency and a bias toward shipping

Nice to have

  • Experience building product features on top of conversational or voice AI
  • Familiarity with LLM observability/eval tooling, even if you're not the one owning it
  • Experience partnering closely with UX research or qualitative research teams
  • Direct experience talking to users or running lightweight user research yourself

Of course, what is outlined above is an ideal set of expectations; however, business needs and other projects and tasks may shift, and additional tasks could be assigned at the discretion of your manager. If this role excites you but you're not sure you check every box, we'd still love to hear from you.

Dscout is a team of passionate, empathetic, and curious professionals. As a recognized leader in the Forrester Wave, we’re at the cutting edge of experience research technology. The power of research drives us - how in-context insights from real people can build more enjoyable products and services.
We prioritize learning, sharing, and building. We also deeply value being a diverse and inclusive team and company and look for team members who align with that belief. Join our dynamic team and help shape product roadmaps and business strategies for the world’s most loved brands.

jobs.excerpt: After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops.
jobs.description:
After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving
upmarket.This role is the person who helps build the commercial motion as we shift towards increasingly complex upmarket accounts.

Role Overview

As Manager of Mid-Market Sales for Toast Retail, you will lead a small team of Mid-Market Account Executives pursuing multi-location retail with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not exist at Toast Retail yet. You will build it.

This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a playbook and run it well. There is no Mid-Market Toast Retail playbook. A growing set of proof points from our SMB business, a leadership team that is investing, and a set of open questions that someone has to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner? Which of our SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form the hypotheses, run them in the field, and turn what works into something repeatable that the next ten AEs can execute.

Expect to spend real time outside your own team. Getting this motion off the ground means sitting with Product on inventory and scan data gaps, with Marketing on messaging that lands with a category buyer, with Enablement on training that does not exist yet, with Deal Desk and Finance on structures we have not offered before, and with Onboarding on implementations that are meaningfully harder than a single site install. Your ability to move those partners without formal authority over any of them will matter as much as your ability to coach a deal.

This is a player coach role in year one. You will carry a number yourself while you hire and build the team, which means you will be closing Mid-Market Retail deals before you are coaching them. That is deliberate. The person who writes this playbook should draw from their own first-hand experiences from running the motion, not just observations of other people running it. As the team scales, your quota shifts to theirs.

You will report to the VP of Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations up to 40 percent of the time.

A day in the life

  • Carry and deliver an individual quota in year one (player-coach) while you hire, onboard, and ramp your team, transitioning to a full team number as your team scales.
  • Hire, develop, motivate, and manage a quota achieving Mid-Market sales team from the ground up, setting the bar for talent in a brand new function
  • Build and codify the Mid-Market Retail sales process: discovery frameworks, demo flows, business case models, mutual action plans, and executive proposals tailored to grocery, liquor, and convenience buyers
  • Run a disciplined sales process and coach your team on qualification rigor, multithreading, and champion development inside complex retail organizations
  • Own live Mid-Market deals end to end yourself, then convert what you learn into discovery frameworks, demo flows, business cases, and proposals the team can run
  • Get in the field. Join discovery calls, sit in on site visits, and walk stores with your reps so the playbook you write is grounded in what actually happens in front of a customer
  • Own all stages of the sales lifecycle with your team: pipeline generation, executive meetings, value proposition development, deal structuring, negotiation, and close
  • Partner across Product, Marketing, Enablement, Deal Desk, Finance, and Onboarding to close the gaps that stand between us and a repeatable Mid-Market motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself
  • Bring the voice of the Mid-Market retailer back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes
  • Forecast accurately in a business with little historical data, and be honest about what you know versus what you are still learning
  • Assess and engage in competitive RFPs
  • Leverage GTM tech stack to run an efficient, AI-anchored motion: establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet, and report on them credibly.
  • Distinguish repeatable process from one off hero deals, and build only the former into the playbook
  • Stay close to the competitive landscape across grocery, liquor, and convenience technology, and position Toast Retail sharply against incumbents

What you'll need to thrive

  • 5+ years of sales experience in a sourcing and closing role, with a track record in Mid-Market or complex, multi stakeholder deals
  • 3+ years of sales leadership experience with a proven record of building and developing quota achieving teams and excellence in outbound pipeline generation
  • Demonstrated expertise in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiation, and closing with new and existing customers
  • Proficiency with MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, plus disciplined pipeline management and forecasting
  • A closer who is also a builder. You are recently and personally credible in front of a Mid-Market buyer, and you are not looking for a role where you stop selling
  • A genuine founder's mindset. You are energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity, and your instinct when a process is missing is to write it rather than ask for it
  • Exceptional cross functional influence. You have a history of getting Product, Marketing, and Operations partners to move on your priorities without owning them
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to hold the room with executive stakeholders and negotiate complex pricing arrangements
  • Comfortable educating customers and team members on the fundamentals of US credit card processing

What will help you stand out

  • Experience standing up a new segment, vertical, or motion inside an existing company, especially taking an SMB product upmarket
  • Experience selling into or operating within grocery, convenience, liquor, or specialty retail
  • Fluency in the operational realities of retail: inventory depth and SKU management, scan data, shrink, category management, age verification and compliance, fuel and foodservice
  • Experience in a fast paced, high growth technology environment
  • A proven track record of creating a winning culture that performs at a high level

Is this your kind of build?

The best version of this hire is someone who reads a role with this much white space and gets excited rather than nervous, and who wants to close the first ten deals themselves before handing the playbook to a team. If you want to point at a Mid-Market business two years from now and say you built it, we would like to talk.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. jobs.title: Senior Software Code Reviewer
jobs.excerpt: About VettoVetto is a tech company focused on building and scaling high-quality datasets for artificial intelligence systems.
jobs.description:
About Vetto

Vetto is a tech company focused on building and scaling high-quality datasets for artificial intelligence systems. We work at the intersection of human expertise and AI, ensuring that models are trained on technically accurate, well-defined, and realistic data.

Our projects support the training and evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs), where technical rigor and correctness are non-negotiable.

About the Project

This project focuses on the technical review and validation of coding tasks used to train AI models.
Automated code is generated in response to software engineering prompts, and your role is to evaluate whether that code is correct and truly solves what was asked.

The core questions you will be answering on every task:

  • Is the coding task technically well-defined?
  • Does the generated code actually solve the problem?
  • Are the associated tests robust, correct, and aligned with real-world software behavior?

Tests are treated as the mechanism of truth in this context. Mistakes here propagate at scale into AI systems, error criticality is high.

Languages

Tasks in this project involve code written across multiple languages. You will be expected to review and evaluate tasks in any of the following: Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Go, Rust, and Java.

Strong command of at least two of these languages is required. Breadth across languages is a plus.

Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze generated code against the original software engineering prompt
  • Evaluate whether the coding task itself is clearly and correctly defined
  • Validate whether tests accurately reflect whether the problem has been solved
  • Identify gaps, ambiguities, false positives, and false negatives in test suites
  • Determine whether a solution that passes the tests genuinely solves the underlying problem
  • Apply strict technical criteria and quality standards consistently across tasks

Required Profile

This role is designed for mid/senior-level software engineers with real professional experience.

Technical requirements

  • Proven professional experience in software development (production environments)
  • Strong command of at least two of the listed languages
  • Experience reviewing and evaluating code written by other engineers
  • Solid understanding of automated testing — how tests validate (or fail to validate) behavior
  • Experience contributing to or working with open source projects
  • High attention to detail and strong technical judgment
  • Comfortable working fully in English (reading and writing)

Nice to have

  • Experience with test-driven development (TDD) or test design
  • Familiarity with large or complex codebases
  • Background in AI, ML, or data-centric projects

Project Details

This is expert, task-based technical work focused on analysis, validation, and judgment — not code production. Each task takes approximately 30 minutes. Tasks are reviewed under continuous QA and calibration.

Compensation is in the range of $100 per hour (task-equivalent reference), varying based on task complexity and approved volume.

Selection Process

The selection process is fully asynchronous and based on your application. There are no interviews: we evaluate candidates through their background, screening responses, and a short technical exercise focused on code review and test validation.

No traditional interviews required.

Final Note

This role is not about writing more code. It is about technical judgment, rigor, and responsibility.

If you are comfortable challenging problem definitions, questioning tests that "pass but are wrong", and acting as a technical quality gate, this project is for you!

Specialist, Development Communications

Our Organization

The Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) is an independent nonprofit that puts rigorous, independent science into action, developing solutions and advocating for a healthy, safe, and just future. We envision a peaceful, healthy, and just world where science serves people and the planet by guiding policy decisions, reducing risks, and improving lives.

For over five decades, we have been working as scientists, engineers, economists, advocates, and everyday people to create and advocate for innovative, practical solutions to some of our planet’s most pressing problems—from combating global warming and developing sustainable ways to feed, power, and transport ourselves, to fighting disinformation, advancing racial equity, and reducing the threat of nuclear war. Values informing our work include:

  • Science in the service of people and the planet.
  • Justice and Equity for people of all races and incomes—now, and for future generations.
  • Courage to take principled, science-based stands in the public arena.
  • Integrity to always examine evidence critically, openly, and honestly.
  • Democracy to promote a voice for all in government decisions.
  • Action inspiring and mobilizing people to build a healthier, safer, and more just world.

The Position

The Development Communications Specialist supports the UCS Development Team in raising $40-$50M annually through creating dedicated content for fundraising collateral for a wide range of donor audiences (with a particular focus on Major and Mid-Level Donors and Family Foundations). They work collaboratively across teams to translate the organization and its program priorities into narratives that steward established donors and cultivate new ones to invest meaningfully into the organizational vision through strategies and timebound tactics that result in measurable impact. The Development Communications Specialist will curate anecdotes that exemplify our work through compelling storytelling that pulls on heart, while balancing those narratives with data and visuals that demonstrate tangible impacts. This role will report into the Stewardship, Engagement, and Events team but have a strong and collaborative working relationship with the Major Gifts, Membership, and other Development teams.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate across teams and internal stakeholders to develop compelling proposals, reports and other donor communications collateral, with a focus on Major Gift and Family Foundation donor audiences.
  • Build relationships and information bridges with program teams to support the translation of programmatic priorities and workplans into compelling donor-facing narratives, and to deliver rapid response donor communications on programmatic developments, achievements, and related news events that impact the trajectory of UCS strategies.
  • Develop donor-targeted program narratives that are solutions-oriented, impact-driven, and combine compelling data that demonstrates our theory of change and measures progress with storytelling that illustrates our work in action and the results of that work.
  • Serve as a Development department-wide resource to share updated donor-ready programmatic language, ensuring consistent and updated language is used by Major Gifts, Stewardship, Membership and other teams.
  • Coordinate and lead on creation of portfolio-wide communications (e.g. acknowledgement letters, bi-annual appeals, cultivation mailings, event invites, etc.).
  • Develop three-to-five program briefs annually for donors that offer compelling solutions and impact-oriented narrative that set up major gifts officers up for success in their personalized solicitation strategies.  
  • Project management, including working in collaboration with Development, Communications, and Data teams to manage lists, liaise with mail houses/vendors, assemble content, etc.
  • Maintain major donor and family foundation proposal report calendar, and assist in assembling materials, drafting/designing/repurposing materials.
  • Assist in preparing briefing materials for donor meetings, among other copy-editing, writing, communications-related responsibilities.
  • Ensure proper data management and coding to support accurate and thoughtful inclusion (or exclusion) of MG donor/ prospect audiences within various communication streams across development and the organization. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

· Continuously operate a computer and must have the ability to control a mouse and keyboard.

At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet. We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.

Additionally, you will enjoy:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; we also offer a company-paid health care concierge service to help navigate our health plan to make the best decisions for you and yours
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation, sick, personal and parental leave time
• Paid Volunteer Time: giving back to our communities is important to us
• Employee Recognition Program – convert your recognition points into gift cards
• Employee Assistance Program – offers benefits to help you manage daily responsibilities
• Access to on-demand training courses to advance further in your career

Job Description

The position is remotely based in Michigan.

We are looking for a talented individual to join the team as a Building Science Analyst! The Building Science Analyst acts as a program's technical expert. This includes conducting desktop project verifications, ensuring Trade Ally adherence to the program, Department of Energy, and any additional state standards, providing guidance and training to participating trade allies, and using building rating and energy modeling tools.

Here at CLEAResult, you will fit right in with our energetic team if you are resourceful, resilient, and kind. ​

​

For this opportunity, you’re a great fit if you can…

  • Ensure program designs reflect actual installation guidelines and minimums for measures in applicable markets.

  • Develops technical training materials and conducts training for internal and external participants.

  • Serves as organization technical spokesperson; approves technical communication and representation to partner programs, clients, regional technical forums/boards.

  • Delivers trade ally training.

  • Understands evaluation risks and develops and communicates strategies.

  • QCs complex measure and modeling runs.

  • Develops protocols for interpretation of specifications, guidelines, manuals, and technical requirements.

  • Provide building science adjustments to measures from contractors.

  • Ensure program designs reflect program installation guidelines

  • Serve as a technical spokesperson to customers and contractors alike.

  • Deliver trade ally guidance and training.

  • Evaluate and understand project risks.

  • Assist in documenting observations regarding project scope, planning and effectiveness of products and services

  • Assist in developing protocols for interpretation of specifications, guidelines, manuals and technical requirements.

  • Reviews documents for technical accuracy and sound building science practices.

  • Attend and participate in required program meetings and training courses

  • Ability to adapt to an ever-changing work environment

  • Time and schedule management skills are a MUST

In this exciting career opportunity, you will have…

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience required (eg. HVAC, electrical, residential construction, building maintenance, general contracting, etc.)

  • Bachelors in Building Science or related program preferred.

  • A strong knowledge of building science and building science applications is required.

  • BPI Building Analyst Professional (BA-P) certification or the ability to obtain a BA-P certification within the first 60 days of employment is required.

  • Excellent communication, organizational, mathematical, and documentation skills; meticulous attention to detail.

  • High school diploma.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

  • Salesforce experience preferred.

  • Knowledge with Energy Star, AHRI, BPI Standards, and NREL Standard Work Specifications a plus.

$61,500-$70,000

jobs.title: Senior Energy Consultant
jobs.excerpt: At World Fuel, our employees are the key to our global success.
jobs.description:
At World Fuel, our employees are the key to our global success. We are industry leaders due to the innumerable talents of our approximately 5000 strong professional team. Our people thrive in an entrepreneurial and culturally-diverse environment, where innovative thinking, collaboration and efficient execution are highly valued. Our high-performance culture is what allows us to drive sustained growth. Stronger together, we promote an environment where individuals can thrive.

Senior Energy Consultant

Preferred locations: Central/Eastern Pennsylvania, Pittsburgh Region, or Greater Chicago Area

Help Organizations Navigate Complex Energy Decisions

World Fuel is seeking a relationship-focused Senior Energy Consultant to help commercial, industrial, healthcare, education, municipal, and nonprofit organizations make informed energy procurement decisions.

This is not a traditional sales role. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to your clients, helping them understand energy markets, evaluate procurement options, manage risk, and identify opportunities to reduce energy costs. You'll build long-term relationships while guiding customers through complex electricity and natural gas purchasing decisions.

Whether your background is in energy consulting, business development, account management, financial services, insurance brokerage, or another consultative sales environment, we're looking for professionals who enjoy building relationships, solving problems, and delivering value to clients.

You'll join one of the most established energy procurement and consulting teams in the PJM market, supporting customers throughout Pennsylvania, Ohio, Illinois, and surrounding deregulated energy markets.

What You'll Do

Build Trusted Client Relationships

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to commercial and industrial energy customers.
  • Develop long-term client relationships based on trust, responsiveness, and expertise.
  • Manage accounts throughout the customer lifecycle, including renewals, procurement planning, and ongoing energy strategy discussions.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and communicate market trends, pricing changes, and regulatory updates.

Advise Clients on Energy Procurement

  • Guide clients through electricity and natural gas purchasing decisions.
  • Evaluate supplier proposals and procurement options.
  • Lead competitive RFP processes and supplier negotiations.
  • Help customers understand market drivers, capacity charges, transmission costs, and pricing risk.
  • Support energy management, demand response, sustainability, and cost-reduction initiatives.
  • Partner with internal subject matter experts to deliver sophisticated market and risk management solutions.

Develop New Business Opportunities

  • Generate new opportunities through referrals, networking, chambers of commerce, trade associations, affinity partners, and existing client relationships.
  • Build relationships with business owners, CFOs, operations leaders, and other decision-makers.
  • Expand existing client relationships and identify additional opportunities to support their energy needs.
  • Present energy solutions and market insights to prospective clients.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in consultative sales, account management, business development, financial services, insurance brokerage, energy consulting, client advisory services, or a related customer-facing profession.
  • Demonstrated success building and maintaining long-term client relationships.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to explain complex concepts in a way that is easily understood by business decision-makers.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Willingness to travel locally to meet clients and attend networking and industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in energy consulting, energy procurement, energy brokerage, utility services, or deregulated energy markets.
  • Knowledge of PJM electricity markets.
  • Experience advising commercial or industrial customers.
  • Familiarity with electricity, natural gas, or energy risk management strategies.
  • Active involvement with chambers of commerce, trade associations, economic development groups, or professional networking organizations.
  • Existing relationships within Pennsylvania, Ohio, Illinois, or other PJM markets.

We Also Welcome Candidates From

  • Financial Services
  • Insurance Brokerage
  • Commercial Banking
  • Mortgage Lending
  • Business Consulting
  • Economic Development
  • Professional Services
  • Customer Advisory and Account Management Roles

Travel Requirements

  • Remote position with local and regional travel.
  • Client meetings, networking events, industry conferences, and company meetings as needed.
  • Typical travel may range from 10% to 50% depending on territory and business activity.
  • Limited overnight travel.

Why Join World Fuel

  • Join one of the largest and most respected energy advisory organizations in the PJM market.
  • Receive warm referral opportunities through chambers, associations, and strategic partners.
  • Build expertise in energy procurement, power markets, sustainability, and risk management.
  • Work in a highly collaborative, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Partner with experienced energy professionals and subject matter experts.
  • Opportunity for professional advancement within a global energy organization.
  • Competitive compensation, incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits.

If you enjoy developing relationships, helping customers solve complex business challenges, and serving as a trusted advisor, we'd love to speak with you.

#WFS

World Fuel is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.Kinect Energy, Inc.

jobs.description:
Cynet Health is looking for a creative, self-driven Communications Specialist to own day-to-day social content across our four brand pages. This is a hands-on content and engagement role for someone who can turn ideas into scroll-stopping posts, write in a distinct brand voice, build genuine community on LinkedIn, and keep a consistent publishing rhythm across multiple audiences. Healthcare staffing experience is a strong plus.

*** To apply, submit your resume and a portfolio or samples of social media content you have created ***

What you'll do:

  • Create content for four brand pages — plan, write, and publish social content for Cynet Health, Cynet Locums, Cynet Systems, and Cynet Health Canada, each with its own voice and audience.
  • Focus on LinkedIn and Facebook — develop engaging post copy and content for our primary channels, with LinkedIn as the priority platform.
  • Build community on LinkedIn — actively engage with our audience by responding to comments, joining relevant conversations, connecting with industry voices, and growing meaningful engagement around each brand.
  • Own the content calendar — maintain a consistent posting schedule across all pages and plan content around campaigns, awareness dates, and industry moments.
  • Write strong hooks — craft post copy that opens with a compelling first line and drives engagement, not generic filler.
  • Partner with our design team — work with our in-house graphic designers to bring posts to life visually, providing clear creative direction for graphics and video.
  • Manage reputation — monitor and respond to reviews on Glassdoor, Indeed, and Google.
  • Track what works — monitor engagement metrics and use insights to continuously improve content performance.

Requirements

What you bring:

  • Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience creating and publishing social media content, with a focus on LinkedIn and Facebook.
  • A portfolio of authored posts and campaigns that demonstrate strong hooks, distinct brand voice, and measurable engagement.
  • Proven ability to adapt tone and messaging across multiple brand pages and audiences.
  • Strong understanding of LinkedIn best practices and community building.
  • Experience in healthcare, staffing, or recruitment communications is preferred.
  • Excellent written English with a sharp sense of brand voice and tone.
  • Self-directed and organized, able to manage a multi-brand calendar with minimal oversight.
  • Must be willing to work night shifts to support US operational hours.

Benefits

jobs.title: Executive Director, Regional Accounts East
jobs.excerpt: Join Immatics and shape the future of cancer immunotherapy; one patient at a time!
jobs.description:
Join Immatics and shape the future of cancer immunotherapy; one patient at a time!

Immatics is committed to making a meaningful impact on the lives of patients with cancer. We are the global leader in precision targeting of PRAME, a target expressed in more than 50 cancers. Our cutting-edge science and robust clinical pipeline form the broadest PRAME franchise with the most PRAME indications and modalities, spanning TCR T-cell therapies and TCR bispecifics.

Why Join Us?

  • Innovative Environment: Help to pioneer advancements in cancer immunotherapy.

  • Collaborative Culture: Be part of a diverse team dedicated to your professional growth.

  • Global Impact: Contribute to therapies that make a lasting impact on patients globally.

Role Overview

Immatics is preparing to launch its first TCR T-cell therapy for metastatic or unresectable melanoma and is seeking an execution-oriented Executive Director, Regional Accounts – East to build and lead a team of Cellular Therapy Account Managers (CTAMs) supporting Authorized Treatment Centers (ATCs) across the Eastern U.S. Reporting to the Vice President, National Accounts, this leader will oversee the hiring, development, and performance of the East region CTAM team while strengthening partnerships with ATCs and ensuring a seamless patient journey from referral through infusion and long-term follow-up. This is a foundational leadership opportunity to help shape Immatics’ commercial launch infrastructure and approach to ATC engagement for a first-in-class TCR T-cell therapy.


Reports to: Vice President, National Accounts  
Location: Field – based / Remote – must reside within the Eastern United States

Salary Range: $300,000 - $330,000

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required.

  • 15 years of biotechnology or pharmaceutical commercial experience, including oncology or specialty product launches.

  • 5+ years of direct people-management experience leading field-based account management, sales, or reimbursement teams.

  • Demonstrated experience calling on academic medical centers, NCI-designated cancer centers, and/or complex health systems.

  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively (approximately 50-60%) across the Eastern U.S.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, or related field).

  • Experience with CAR-T, TCR-T, or other autologous/personalized cell and gene therapies, including familiarity with Authorized Treatment Center or Qualified Treatment Center network models.

  • Established relationships with melanoma and cell therapy treating physicians, cell therapy program directors, and nurse navigators/coordinators at leading cancer centers in the Eastern U.S.

  • Deep understanding of the personalized cell therapy patient journey, including referral, apheresis scheduling, vein-to-vein logistics, bridging therapy, conditioning regimens, infusion, and long-term follow-up.

  • Experience launching a first-in-class or first-in-indication oncology therapy.

  • Track record of building and scaling a field team in a pre-launch or early-launch environment.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience in forecasting, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and performance reporting.

In this role you will:

  • Recruit, hire, train, and lead a high-performing team of Cellular Therapy Account Managers across the Eastern U.S.

  • Set clear performance expectations, provide ongoing coaching, and conduct regular field rides and business reviews with each CTAM.

  • Own the overall relationship strategy for Authorized Treatment Centers across the East, including academic medical centers, NCI-designated cancer centers, and community oncology networks.

  • Guide CTAMs in supporting ATC onboarding, certification, and readiness activities, including training on the referral pathway, scheduling, and logistics unique to personalized cell therapy.

  • Partner with ATC Operations, Patient Operations, Market Access, Medical Affairs, and Patient Services to ensure a seamless patient journey from referral to infusion.

  • Develop and execute the East region account strategy and business plan in alignment with national commercial objectives.

  • Serve as the East region point of contact for cross-functional partners, including Market Access, Medical Affairs, ATC Operations, Patient Operations, Patient Services/Hub, Manufacturing, Legal, and Compliance.

Travel required: Significant travel required (approximately 50-60%) to Authorized Treatment Centers, team meetings, and conferences across the East region.

Qualified candidates will participate in a structured interview process, which includes:

  • An initial recruiter phone screen (conducted via video)

  • A recruiter-facilitated introduction and interview with the hiring leader and key stakeholders (via video)

  • A final-stage interview, which may include an in-person meeting at our U.S. Headquarters in Houston, TX

What do we offer? 

At Immatics, we believe in investing in our team’s health, safety and well-being. Here’s what you can expect if you join Immatics

 

Comprehensive Benefits: 

  • Competitive rates for Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance

  • PTO Accrued bi-weekly, with up to 80 hours available to borrow and a maximum accrued balance of 240 hours.

  • 12 company paid holidays

  • 10 days of sick time

  • 100% employer-paid life insurance up to at 1x annual salary, up to one hundred thousand dollars

  • 100% employer-paid short- and long-Term disability coverage 

  • 401(k) with immediate eligibility and company match…

  • The company will match 100% of your contributions up to 3% of your base salary for the first two years of employment, 4% for years 2-3 of employment, and up to 5% of your salary from the fourth year onward of continued employment.

  • Partially paid parental leave for eligible employees.

  • Additional voluntary employee-paid benefits and services, including accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness insurance, as well as identity theft protection and pet insurance.

Equal Employment Opportunity 

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace.  We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Job Description

At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

What You'll Do:

As our Mid-Market Sales Executive, you’ll bring deep experience across the entire sales cycle and thrive in a high-growth, proactive, technology-driven environment. This role involves direct engagement with senior-level client stakeholders and requires the ability to drive transactions that spark urgency and position our solutions as a top priority within the organization.

You’ll also play a key role in supporting our company's vision toward transformation to a high-impact, solution-based sales approach.
The ideal candidate is a proactive, trusted professional who builds credibility across client organizations. You will bring the business acumen and sophistication to present differentiated sales strategies while understanding what drives decision-making, including risks, opportunities, and priorities.

Success in this role requires strategic thinking, the ability to develop strong business cases, and the skill to influence others effectively. You should be confident navigating complex sales conversations, building pipeline, and presenting high-level, value-driven solutions to executive audiences.

While the role is 100% remote, the individual must reside in São Paulo, and be authorized to work in Brazil.

  • Drive growth and profitability within assigned geography/vertical by consistently meeting or exceeding revenue, margin, and performance targets.

  • Effectively communicate and champion First Advantage’s vision, brand, and strategic value to prospective clients.

  • Identify, develop, and close new sales opportunities to maximize revenue and profitability.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders to enhance communication, retention, and long-term satisfaction.

  • Present and position a configurable, centralized solution that delivers clear ROI through efficiency, compliance, service excellence, and technology innovation.

  • Lead discovery conversations to uncover client needs, overcome objections, and present tailored, strategic business cases.

  • Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline, staying ahead of industry trends and client needs.

  • Provide feedback and insights to product and technology teams to influence innovation and ensure market-relevant solutions.

  • Leverage internal systems and cross-functional teams to optimize solution delivery, product configuration, and client service.

  • Stay current on industry benchmarks, trends, emerging technologies, privacy legislation, and the competitive landscape to inform strategy and ensure compliance.

  • Successfully navigate and close complex, consultative sales cycles with high-level stakeholders.

  • Provide ongoing post-go-live support to customers, ensuring a smooth transition, continued satisfaction, and long term partnership success.

  • Bring a collaborative, strategic mindset with strong critical thinking skills that enhance team credibility and contribute to First Advantage’s industry leadership.

  • Operate with agility and excellence in a fast-paced, dynamic, and performance-driven environment.

What You May Need to be Successful:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

  • 5+ years of consultative sales experience in a progressive, high-performing environment—ideally within human capital, BPO, or technology-based industries.

  • Proven ability to lead strategic discovery conversations, anticipate objections, and clearly articulate the value of a differentiated, high-impact solution

  • Consistent track record of creating urgency and priority within client organizations to drive momentum and close deals.

  • Strong experience negotiating and closing new business, including contracts, pricing, terms, conditions, and service level agreements.

  • Demonstrated success generating leads, building pipeline, and securing executive-level presentation opportunities through proactive, targeted outreach aligned with company goals.

  • Ability to access and influence VP and executive-level decision-makers across prospective client organizations.

  • Results-driven mindset with a history of meeting or exceeding monthly, quarterly, and annual sales quotas.

  • Skilled at accurately forecasting and managing a complex sales cycle involving multiple products and services.

  • Keeps a pulse on market trends, competitor activity, and broader industry shifts to inform sales strategy.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the agility to thrive in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment.

  • Willing and able to travel as needed to meet business objectives.

jobs.description:
Managing modern technology has become increasingly complex. As organizations scale across clouds, endpoints, and hybrid environments, IT operations and cybersecurity often remain fragmented, creating gaps in visibility, slowing response times, and increasing risk.

Logically closes that gap.

We unify IT operations and cybersecurity into a single, accountable operating model that reduces risk, accelerates response, and strengthens resilience across the systems businesses depend on. With shared visibility, integrated workflows, and clear ownership, organizations gain greater control, fewer blind spots, and more confidence in their technology.

Our approach is cyber-first by design, embedding protection into every layer, from end user to edge to cloud. By combining AI-assisted monitoring with human-led expertise, we deliver faster insight, smarter decisions, and more effective outcomes without the complexity of siloed tools.

For more than 20 years, Logically has partnered with mid-market and enterprise organizations to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and improve resilience, acting as a true extension of their teams with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.

Logically. Cyber-First. Future-Ready.

Why Work for Us

  • A culture built on doing the right thing
  • Work at the forefront of cybersecurity and emerging technologies
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented environment
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement
  • Make a real impact by helping organizations reduce risk and build resilience
